notes:
Composed of {実力|じつりょく} (real ability/power) and {者|しゃ} (person). Emphasizes actual power or competence rather than formal title. Often implies behind-the-scenes influence, especially in political contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {政界|せいかい}の{実力者|じつりょくしゃ}: political powerbroker
- {業界|ぎょうかい}の{実力者|じつりょくしゃ}: industry heavyweight
- {地元|じもと}の{実力者|じつりょくしゃ}: local person of influence
- {隠|かく}れた{実力者|じつりょくしゃ}: hidden power player

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {有力者|ゆうりょくしゃ}: influential person — similar but emphasizes social standing and connections
- {権力者|けんりょくしゃ}: person in power — focuses on formal authority
- {実力|じつりょく}: real ability, true strength — the base noun without the person suffix

definitions.explanation: a person who wields real power or has genuine ability; someone influential behind the scenes or through demonstrated competence

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{業界|ぎょうかい}の{実力者|じつりょくしゃ}だ。
examples.english: He is a powerful figure in the industry.

examples.japanese: {地元|じもと}の{実力者|じつりょくしゃ}に{相談|そうだん}した。
examples.english: I consulted with a local person of influence.

examples.japanese: {政界|せいかい}の{実力者|じつりょくしゃ}たちが{裏|うら}で{動|うご}いていたことが{明|あき}らかになった。
examples.english: It was revealed that powerful political figures had been working behind the scenes.
